# test fixtures

## `kb_tool_orig.py`

A frozen, byte-for-byte copy of `scripts/kb_tool.py` **as it was before** multi-path
support was added (the commit immediately preceding the multi-path change).

It exists so `test_multipath_parity.py` can prove the headline guarantee against an
**independent oracle**: resolving N paths in one call of the new tool must produce
exactly the same set of doc roots as looping this original single-path tool over
each path and union-deduping. Comparing the new tool against itself would be
tautological (single-path and multi-path share the same code), so the original is
checked in here verbatim as the reference implementation.

Do not edit this file. If `kb_tool.py`'s single-path contract is ever intentionally
changed, regenerate it from the last pre-change commit:

    git show <pre-change-commit>:plugins/ttadk/mobile-core/skills/kb-update-docs/scripts/kb_tool.py \
      > tests/fixtures/kb_tool_orig.py
